description: Implementation of DigitalProductDao, providing methods to retrieve DigitalProduct entities by Product and by ID, using QueryDSL for JPA queries.

classes.name: DigitalProductDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for DigitalProduct, providing methods to retrieve digital product details based on product or ID.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with the specified merchant store and product. Throws NonUniqueResultException if multiple results found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct by its unique ID.
